title: Directory reorganization: lib/mitosis rename and docs merge

completion_criteria.text: The blast radius is re-derived as a closed census over the CURRENT tree that halts on anything unclassifiable, and every difference from 0340's 17-site count is explained rather than absorbed.
lib/superpowers-parallel becomes lib/mitosis and resolve-superpowers.mjs becomes superpowers-prompts.mjs, every load-bearing path string changing in the SAME commit.
docs/superpowers/{specs,plans} merge into the existing docs/{specs,plans}, and workflows/parallel-plan-execution.js becomes mitosis-execute.js together with its meta.name.
The dead .gitignore line is deleted rather than renamed, since it names a path nothing writes.
Behaviour-neutrality is proven by execution not inspection: drift-check hook, CI phase-parity, npm test glob, pr.mjs imports and mitosis.js LIB_DIR all resolve after the move.
A PR is opened through the centralized pr-create tool from a worktree branch, the primary checkout never leaves main, and phase 2 subdivision is left undone.

spine.active_goal: Execute 0340's decided rename as a pure move with zero behavioural change, prove it neutral by running the checks, and open a PR that is not merged.
spine.next_step: The orchestrator subagent is running the census, move, verification and PR stages in a worktree. On its return, read the census reconciliation FIRST - an unexplained difference from 0340's 17 sites means a referencing site appeared after the audit ran - then the verified versus not-run split, then the PR. Do not merge; merge is human-gated. When this thread closes, return to SPEC B (01KZQ2BVF2386ATV5YFD43NQVX) and resume scoping before any SPEC text is written.
spine.last_session: Opened this thread as a child of SPEC B, recorded 0344, and dispatched the orchestrator subagent with 0340's decided change, the worktree constraint and the closed-census requirement. No code had moved at the time of writing.

open_risks.text: Read the census reconciliation before accepting anything else — an unexplained difference from 0340's 17 sites means a referencing site appeared after the audit ran, which is the exact failure this ordering exists to catch

Never switch branches in the primary checkout — live config resolves through ~/.claude/current into a release directory, so a branch switch in place is the one move that desynchronizes live config from the repository
Confirm the self-referential string inside resolve-superpowers.mjs was changed — it hardcodes its own old path and will not follow its own rename
Confirm mitosis.js LIB_DIR resolves after the move — it is interpolated into subagent prompts, so a stale value produces an agent confidently running a command that 404s
Verify the workflow meta.name changed alongside the filename — the Workflow tool addresses a workflow by that field, so renaming only the file leaves it uninvocable
Audit every Verified line on the PR rather than trusting it — the honesty rule forbids a verified line for a check that was not actually run and read, and a fabricated one reads as assurance

key_decisions.title: The stale superpowers-parallel tree is renamed to lib/mitosis as a pure move before the SPEC
The rename executes in a worktree with the blast radius re-derived rather than trusted

out_of_scope: Phase 2 subdivision of lib/mitosis into engine, recovery, git and gates, deferred by 0340

Any behavioural change at all; this is a pure move
